overview: UNESCO takes applications for a pool of intern candidates for Headquarters, field offices and institutes, for 1 to 6 months. You apply to the pool, not to a specific internship; managers worldwide pick candidates from it.
deadline_text: "Application deadline: 31 December 2026 (Midnight)" (UNESCO posting 'INTERNSHIP: All Sectors/Bureaus', read 12 October 2026). Thirteen of the 14 internship postings on the portal close 31/12/2026.
funding_details: UNESCO: "UNESCO does not remunerate interns. There is no compensation, financial or otherwise for internship assignments."
Interns arrange and pay for their own travel and visa and must show comprehensive health insurance; UNESCO gives only limited workplace insurance.
age_requirement: At least 20 years old to apply
education_requirement: Third or final year of a bachelor's degree, enrolled in a master's or PhD, or graduated no more than 12 months before the internship agreement
nationality_requirements: No nationality condition stated on the posting
eligibility: Third/final-year bachelor's student, master's or PhD student, or graduate of the last 12 months
documents_required: Certificate of enrolment, transcript or diploma (before the internship starts)
application_process: Apply online to one of the internship postings to join the pool; the application stays valid for 6 months
potential_issues: Unpaid: interns pay their own travel, visa and health insurance
You join a candidate pool; there is no guarantee of placement and no reply if not selected
Kinshasa placement not confirmed
action: Apply to the UNESCO internship pool before 31 December 2026 if you can cover your own costs.

title: FAO Internship Programme for Africa (RAF), call open until 31 December 2026
overview: FAO's call for expressions of interest for internships of 3 to 11 months in its offices in Africa, for students and recent graduates aged 21 to 30 in a field related to FAO's work. Candidates join a pool and are contacted by hiring offices.
deadline_text: Posted 21 September 2026; closes 31 December 2026, 11:59 PM (FAO careers, job 2601980, read 12 October 2026). FAO notes that the time shown depends on the reader's device settings.
funding_details: FAO: "FAO provides a monthly stipend to interns if they are not sponsored by sending universities or other entities." No amount is stated.
FAO: "FAO does not charge any fee at any stage of the recruitment process".
stipend: Monthly stipend if not sponsored by a university or other body (amount not stated)
experience_requirement: Relevant academic studies in one of FAO's fields; no work experience stated
education_requirement: Enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree at a recognised (WHED-listed) institution, or a recent graduate, in a field relevant to FAO
language_requirement: Working knowledge of one FAO language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish)
eligibility: Student or recent graduate of a WHED-listed institution in a field relevant to FAO
Working knowledge of one FAO language
Appropriate residence or immigration status in the country of assignment
No previous FAO internship; no parent or sibling employed by FAO
documents_required: Proof of enrolment at a recognised university or copy of academic qualifications
application_process: Complete an online profile on the FAO jobs site and apply to job 2601980

title: UNFPA Global Internship Roster 2026
overview: UNFPA's roster for internships in its offices in 2026. Students and recent graduates apply once to the roster; offices pick interns from it. The posting does not name the offices.
deadline_text: Posted 16 January 2026; the posting ends 1 January 2027 04:59 UTC, i.e. 31 December 2026 at 23:59 New York time (UNFPA careers posting 31319, read 12 October 2026).
funding_details: UNFPA: "Interns who do not receive financial support from an outside party (such as an academic institution, university, government) are eligible to receive a stipend as a contribution towards living expenses." No amount is stated; it depends on the place of work.
UNFPA: "UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee".
stipend: Stipend towards living expenses for interns without outside funding (amount not stated)
experience_requirement: No work experience stated; must show interest in development
education_requirement: Enrolled in a first degree with one full academic year completed, or in a postgraduate programme, or graduated within the last year, or in a postgraduate professional trainee programme
language_requirement: English or French, plus fluency in the official language of the UNFPA office
eligibility: First-degree student with one academic year completed, postgraduate student, or graduate starting within one year of graduation
English or French, and the official language of the office
No parent, child or sibling on UNFPA staff
application_process: Apply to posting 31319 on UNFPA's careers site
potential_issues: A roster: applying does not guarantee an internship, and the offices are not named
Whether the DRC office will take interns from this roster is not stated
Stipend amount not stated
